notes.title: HAPPY HALLOWEEN + POSTER + NEWS!
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween[/b], everyone!

Remember that to celebrate spooky season, [b]Mothmen 1966 is 35% OFF until November 1[/b]! 
If you haven't grabbed it yet, now it's your chance!

Also... [u]Fer made yet another poster![/u]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OU3cZBh.png[/img]

But there's more! We want to keep you posted about our pixel pulp schedule...
[list]
[*] We're wrapping up VARNEY LAKE's production phase (more info on this in the following weeks).
[*] We're entering BAHNSEN KNIGHTS pre-production phase.
[/list]

And you can already wishlist both games on Steam!
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933180/Varney_Lake/]WISHLIST VARNEY LAKE[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933190/Bahnsen_Knights/]WISHLIST BAHNSEN KNIGHTS[/url]
[/list]

Also, we're working on some QOL changes to our Pixel Pulps, so there's going to be a MOTHMEN 1966 update down the line.

Remember that you can reach us on [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=discord.gg/nnnBbJU3nq]Discord[/url].

That's all, lots to work on, but really happy and grateful for your continuous support!
- [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]LCB Game Studio[/url] -

notes.title: NEW MOTHMEN 1966 DEMO!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BhED7X1.png[/img]

Hey, everyone!

Our friends and publishers at [url=https://twitter.com/ChorusWorldwide]Chorus Worldwide[/url] are showing Mothmen 1966 new demo at WASD, in London. As many won't be able to make it —including us! London is really far from Buenos Aires, our hometown in Argentina— we are showing the same demo on Steam.

This current demo features a new UI, new title screen... and a previously unseen chapter! Go get it!

Note: Mothmen 1966 is shaping up really good, we'll be announcing something cool in a couple of weeks!

You can reach us on [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]Twitter [/url]or join our [url=discord.gg/nnnBbJU3nq]Discord[/url].

Thank again for all your support!
- [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]LCB Game Studio[/url]

notes.title: HALLOWEEN TREATS!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/G5dzqsp.png[/img]

[h3][b]Happy Halloween, pixel pulpers![/b][/h3]

We’re releasing a sweet treat for all of you today… 
An updated demo with a brand new playable prologue!

[h3]Treat includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new playable prologue presenting Holt, a gas station and some mysterious visitors!
[*] An updated version of “the coyote puzzle” from the original demo (thanks for all the feedback to those of you that played a previous version, your thoughts were invaluable when polishing the demo!)
[/list] 
Enjoy this treat and tell us what you think about it!
You can reach us on [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]Twitter[/url] or join our [url=discord.gg/nnnBbJU3nq]Discord[/url].

Thank again for all your support!
- [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]LCB Game Studio[/url]

[i]IMPORTANT NOTICE: Demo is going to be up until November 10th, so go play it now![/i]

notes.title: NEWS UPDATE #1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who played the Mothmen 1966 demo! 

Having so many people enjoy our first Pixel Pulp has been amazing, and the feedback invaluable. We've taken down the demo so that we can work on it and improve it based on the feedback we've received. 

But please keep a close eye on us—here and on [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]Twitter[/url]—for news of when you'll be able to play it again. 

Thank you once more for all your support!
 - [url=https://twitter.com/lcbgamestudio]LCB Game Studio[/url]

[i]PS. Just 10 more days for Halloween, right? RIGHT? 
Stay tuned for something weirdly special![/i]
